crossRefs.note: Then he measured the wall of the house, six cubits; and the width of every side room, four cubits, all around the house…
The doors of the side rooms were toward an open area that was left, one door toward the north, and another door toward…
Then he brought me out into the outer court, the way toward the north. Then he brought me into the room that was…
Before the rooms was a walk of ten cubits’ width inward, a way of one cubit; and their doors were toward the north.

translations.web: The thickness of the wall, which was for the side rooms, on the outside, was five cubits. That which was left was the place of the side rooms that belonged to the house.
translations.bsb: The outer wall of the side rooms was five cubits thick, and the open area between the side rooms of the temple
translations.kjv: The thickness of the wall, which was for the side chamber without, was five cubits: and that which was left was the place of the side chambers that were within.
translations.asv: The thickness of the wall, which was for the side-chambers, on the outside, was five cubits: and that which was left was the place of the side-chambers that belonged to the house.
